name: Golden Rose
description: Rose is a plant of the genus Rosa in the family Rosaceae. In daily life, it is the collective name for a series of cultivated varieties of the genus Rosa with large and showy flowers. Rose fruits are edible, sugar-free and rich in vitamin C. They are commonly used in vanilla tea, jam, jelly, juice and bread. Roses are originally from China. The golden rose is a kind of brass craft flower. The golden rose is designed according to the style of a rose. The flowers and leaves are made of brass material. It is a flower that will never wither or deform, symbolizing the eternity of love, family, and friendship.
